answer:
Under Irish UCITS rules, the **UCITS ETF identifier (“UCITS ETF”) applies at the level of the listed share class**, not automatically to every sub-fund in an umbrella or to every class within a sub-fund.

- **Mixed umbrella:** If only some sub-funds are ETFs, identify those ETF sub-funds/classes as ETFs; do not describe non-ETF sibling sub-funds as ETFs merely because they belong to the same umbrella.
- **One sub-fund, listed and unlisted classes:** The listed class is the ETF class and should carry the identifier. The sub-fund itself may be described as an ETF sub-fund, but that must not imply that its unlisted classes are listed or ETFs. Identify those classes separately as unlisted/non-ETF classes.

In short: distinguish the umbrella, sub-fund and share-class levels; use the ETF identifier for the listed class and avoid applying it umbrella-wide.
